Snow in the City: One winter morning, Leo opens the window. Everything is white! It snows at night. This is the first snow of the year.
The buses are slow, so Leo walks to school with his friends. They play with the snow on the way. They make snowballs and a small snowman with a red hat.
At school, the teacher says the snow is good for the plants. It keeps them warm in the cold winter. Leo looks out of the window. The snowman is still there, smiling at him.
